scope: Tenant-local Observing Operation query scheduling, independent capture, reconciliation, and terminal CAS
summary: Added a bounded Observing Operation worker that skips active leases and already-evidenced operations, claims a fresh worker lease, revalidates a separate query authority, commits a budgeted query exit, captures raw/normalized evidence and an operation receipt, compares the complete receipt vector under the installed rule, and applies only a conclusive report with worker fencing. Ambiguity and transport failure remain Observing.
boundaries: No global tenant discovery or production process manager is claimed
Real Provider credentials, production query policy, and deployment governance remain external
Transport ambiguity never becomes a no-effect or success assertion
